the leading cause for the enhancement in RT yield strength with Ta increasing is the antiphase boundary (APB) strengthening of the bimodal γ' precipitates

(1) The RT strength of PM superalloy is enhanced due to the Ta additive, and the tensile ductility is slightly reduced, but the impact absorbed energy of the 4.8Ta alloy drops rapidly. This phenomenon is attributed to the fact that Ta promotes Mo and Cr being segregated to the grain boundary after standard heat treatment.
According to the yield strength models, the addition of Ta reduces the solid solution strengthening effect, but the σAPB is indeed increased.
